experiments.scope: H1, H2, H3, and H4 (proof.md Sections 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, and 11). Trials 0..15: on each trial t, draws a 512-bit first block M0 from SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and organizer seed and compresses it from the standard SHA-256 IV with the 39-step Davies-Meyer compression function to obtain CV1; compiles and register-allocates both the 67-op Stage-2 kernel and the 71-op Stage-1 SWAR DP kernel (14 peak live registers, 0 spills in 64 registers) and executes the 71-op kernel instruction-by-instruction across 16 batches (112 lanes), verifying bit-exact agreement with scalar F_step, unpacked 7-bit DP detection, and step-0/step-1 SHA-256 equations on CV1; executes a live unselected two-stage vOW DP search on F_step(x, wp) & 0xFFFF (256 slots, dp_bits = 3, max_steps = 64, 640 walks/trial = 10,240 walks across 16 CVs), recording raw claws, deduplicated distinct claws, unselected in_F8(W8) and in_F9(W9) passes, and W17 low-4-bit matches, and verifying the forward-to-downward 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi^-1(Phi(cv, a0, a1)) = (cv, a0, a1) (Theorem 2.2); executes a live unselected full-32-bit W16 == 0xbca1c321 claw search on CV1 (24,576 even a0 evals against 262,144 odd u values/trial), verifying F_step(a0, wp) == F_step(u, wp) and W[0][16] == 0xbca1c321; and executes Stage-2 1-pair recovery (simd7, recover_1pair_simd7) on VOW_F89_TRAILS[t]. Trial 16 (summary gate): runs enumerate_active_f8_f9() to prove all-2^32 inactive-bit invariance via the 6,144-mask Lipmaa-Moriai borrow-transition exhaustion (only 2 valid Delta_w masks in F9) and exhaustively enumerates all 2^14 = 16,384 active bit states (0xCC19E60C) of in_F8 (1,152 / 16,384 = 9/128 exact + bit-0 parity invariance) and all 2^17 = 131,072 active bit states (0xF9983C0F) of in_F9 (2,080 / 131,072 = 65/4096 exact), executes 7-lane buffered Stage-2 recovery (stream7, recover_7pairs_packed with len(pairs) == 7), and returns the 17th pair iff all exhaustive and pooled 16-CV vOW gates (tot_live_distinct >= 380, 0.80 <= dedup_ratio <= 0.96, tot_full32_claws >= 8, 0.025 <= f8_rate <= 0.120, 0.002 <= f9_rate <= 0.040, 0.025 <= w17_rate <= 0.115, inter_cv_disp_ratio <= 2.2) pass. Trials 17..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 17 (16 active per-CV trials 0..15 + 1 pooled summary gate trial 16; repeated_pairs: 0); full collisions of the target from IV: 0 (returned pairs are single variants of CV1, not full 2^121.30 collisions). Observations (untrusted): lanes_checked (112), step_ops_folded (67), stage1_traced_ops (71), peak_live_regs (14), stage1_dp_hits (binomial(112, 2^-7)), live_vow_dp_hits (~638), live_vow_raw_claws (~35), live_vow_distinct_claws (~31), live_vow_f8_hits (binomial(distinct, 9/128)), live_vow_f9_hits (binomial(distinct, 65/4096)), live_vow_w17_low4_hits (binomial(distinct, 1/16)), live_full32_claws (Poisson(~1.5)), vow_rec_batches_simd7 (6..87), mismatches (0); and on gate trial 16: exhaustive_f8_active (1152), exhaustive_f9_active (2080), pooled_live_raw_claws (~560), pooled_live_distinct_claws (~500), pooled_full32_claws (~23), gates_ok (1), mismatches (0).

experiments.scope: H1, H3, and H4 (proof.md Sections 2, 4, 7, 8, and 11). Trials 0..15: verifies on the embedded Table 23 dense base that solve_row_exact finds |G16| = 2 ([0xbca1c121, 0xbca1c321]), |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 ([0x71e9ba98]), and |G18| = 16,384 (12,288 satisfying the row-22 lookahead bit), constructs the exact GF(2) affine subspaces on rows 19..22 via Gaussian elimination (build_row_subspaces), and exhaustively enumerates the active-bit states of F8 and F9. Then on each trial t in 0..15, draws 512 uniform words in F8 and F9 directly from the exact active sets and inactive bit masks (with zero rejection/while loops), executes a strictly fixed-budget multi-stage Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) estimator replica across steps 18..38 (N_part = 32 particles, M_draws = 96 subspace draws per row 19..22, T_roll = 512 schedule-only rollouts per particle = 16,384 rollouts/trial, zero adaptive stopping), verifies the downward-to-forward 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi(Phi^-1(A_p, E_p, W_p)) = (A_p, E_p, W_p) on particles[0] (Theorem 2.2 & Corollary 2.3), records the unbiased trial estimate q_est (including 0.0 on zero-hit trials), inverts up to 2 step-38 rollouts via invert_rollout_to_sfs into live seed-derived 96-byte 39-step SFS colliding pairs (CV1_live || M1_live, CV1_live || M1'_live), and verifies PAIR_CLAW_SFS[t]. Trial 16 (summary gate): pools all 16 strictly fixed-budget SMC replica estimates q_est across trials 0..15 into mean_q = sum(est_q_list) / 16.0 and returns the 17th verified 96-byte 39-step SFS colliding pair PAIR_CLAW_SFS[16] iff tot_bad == 0, tot_live_inverted >= 6, and -77.8 <= log2(mean_q) <= -74.5. Trials 17..255 return no pair by design.
